ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited has issued a routine intimation announcing its upcoming Adani Annual Conference 2026 in Singapore on November 18-19, where it will conduct physical one-on-one and group interactions with investors and analysts. No immediate material financial impacts or red flags are evident from this purely informational announcement, as it primarily serves to inform stakeholders of the scheduled investor event.
